# awscontrib_connect_queue_quick_connect_associations (Resource)

Manages a set of Amazon Connect queue-to-quick-connect associations. Mutations for the same instance and queue are serialized within one provider process.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awscontrib_connect_queue_quick_connect_associations" "example" {
  instance_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-111111111111"
  queue_id    = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-222222222222"

  quick_connect_ids = toset([
    "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-333333333333",
    "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-444444444444",
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.
- `queue_id` (String) Amazon Connect queue identifier.
- `quick_connect_ids` (Set of String) The unique quick-connect UUIDs managed by this resource. Amazon Connect accepts at most 50 IDs per association request.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import awscontrib_connect_queue_quick_connect_associations.example 'aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-111111111111:aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-222222222222:aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-333333333333,aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-444444444444'
```
